format: JSON companion to Dexter's tools/ai-eval/scenarios.ts (npm run eval:ai). Each scenario carries group, turn and noSolution in his exact Scenario/Turn shape (confront characterIds are [addressed, partner]); setup is data instead of a setup function and maps onto his helpers (discoveredEvidenceIds -> discoverAll or a subset, characters.X.revealedSecretIds -> reveal, stress -> stress, evidenceShownIds -> shown; testimonyShownIds has no helper yet). One object per scenario. setup: discoveredEvidenceIds plus per-character runtime (stress, evidenceShownIds, testimonyShownIds, revealedSecretIds); the game-wide revealedSecretIds is the union of every character's. input: the player's question plus at most one presentedEvidenceId or presentedTestimonyId. kind 'confront': 'addressed' answers first and throws its testimony at 'partner' (the suspect under test), as in ai/confront-handler.ts; both get CONFRONTATION_PRESSURE first. engine: deterministic expectations checked by tests/cases/blackwood-leak-scenarios.test.ts (revealSecretId of the suspect under test, newlyExposedLieIds, stonewallLieIds, secretsInPrompt, hiddenFactIds that must not be in the prompt). allowed / forbidden: what the model reply may and may not say. forbidden.phrases are JavaScript regex sources, case-insensitive, meant for the reply text. allowedExamples must match no forbidden phrase; forbiddenExamples must each match one.
